title: Guard402 Autonomous MCP Security, Web Sanitizer & DeFi Audit Suite Input
description: Select the security audit, web extraction, or DeFi intelligence action to execute and provide the target URL, repository, contract address, or untrusted prompt.

action.title: Suite Action
action.description: The security or intelligence operation to execute.

target.title: Target (Repo URL / Web URL / Token or Contract Address / Prompt)
target.description: GitHub repository URL (for audit_mcp_repo), untrusted prompt text (for sanitize_prompt), web URL (for stealth_extract), Base token/contract 0x address (for scan_base_token / contract_audit), or market query (for polymarket_whale_radar).

include_patch.title: Include AutoPatch Vault Remediation Diff
include_patch.description: If true, generates a deterministic unified diff security patch preview and attaches x402 AutoPatch Vault metadata.

strict_mode.title: Strict Security Mode
strict_mode.description: Enforce strict SSRF filtering, zero-trust prompt redaction, and conservative bytecode risk scoring.
